rows.claim: Thumper's creature type is 16, whereas type 29 is Molt.
In the Moonlit hardware arm Thumper occupied slot 10 and initially had health 50.
Each individual purple-berry hit removed four health points from Thumper in the recorded Moonlit arm.
Transplanting Thumper's creature row automatically brought his Council Chamber health bar and boss win sequence into Moonlit.
Thumper's buzzing sound is audible to a player in Moonlit Cliffs.
Purple projectiles actually lock onto the transplanted Thumper after he wakes.

The yellow leaves received newly invented approximate collision shells instead of translated original strips.
Publishing the collision fix required changing the bugs.exe bytes from the preceding production.

The new collision pieces lower the hardware frame rate by exactly two frames per second.

The extended camera guard contains 88 rows covering Moonlit, the Journey hub and rooms R through Z.
All 765 CD files were byte-identical between the camera-fix production and its preceding production.
The camera-fix experiment checked every room from R through Z in hardware.
The October 2 room themes introduced the geometry that first caused the green band.
A hardware visit to room S would show no green band at any camera pose with this guard installed.
Players find the guard's possible whole-face popping at the 32k boundary visually acceptable.
